It flashes the verse too, if it happens to be on screen. Editing a comment therefore moved onto the mark's own `⋮` (**Edit Comment**), so one gesture means one thing on both kinds of mark. The whole row is set in the bible key's own face (`useBibleFontFamily` on the block, inherited — set on the marked words alone it left the comment beside them in the UI font, one line in two scripts); so are the comment editor's title and textarea, and the hover tooltip's text. The row is NOT the ordinary note row: it never double-clicks into the `bible-note` editor (whose first autosave would rewrite `content` and erase the marks), and offers no Export (it IS draggable to another note file, carrying a second `application/x-owa-drag-noteitem` payload — RD-112). With no `CompressionStream` it writes the editor's other documented tag, `base64:`, uncompressed. Past **8 000 characters** the link is copied to the clipboard with a sentence saying to paste it into the address bar instead: measured against this project's own Electron, `shell.openExternal` carried 2 500 and 8 000 whole and DROPPED 30 000 in silence while still resolving, and a press that silently does nothing is the one failure a user cannot diagnose (an ordinary 29-box graph writes a 1 290 character link). Both ride `genShapeBoxStyle`, so the editor canvas, the slide thumbnails, the projector and the print PDF agree (unlike the blend, which is deliberately editor-canvas-only in its shape style). Offsets clamp to ±200px and blur to 0..200px -- a hand-edited value out of range is REPAIRED, never dropped, since one bad token voids the whole CSS declaration. **No Shadow** stores NOTHING, so a document written before this existed round-trips byte for byte |

## XW — Cross-window propagation (multi-renderer edit→present sync)

The class of regression a one-window run misses: OWA windows are **separate renderers**
that sync only via **disk + `fs.watch`**, so an edit in the **separate** `Document Editor`
window must propagate to the Presenter preview / list / live screen. Requires the
**two-window** config (editor opened via NAV-21 external icon → `openPopupWindow`, NOT the
in-place `Slide Editor` tab). Recipe + CDP-drivable-edit techniques (properties numeric
inputs ED-17/ED-19, programmatic `CanvasController`, direct `writeFileData`): KB §12,
test-plan.md §S18. **Prefer a scratch doc; restore via Undo (never Discard).** The chain to
cite when a hop breaks: `writeFileData`→ the ONE recursive `fs.watch` on the **data parent
dir** (`watchDataDir`→`watchDir`→`handleFileEvent`, `src/helper/dirWatchingHelpers.ts`)
→`alertFileChanging`→`FileSource.fireUpdateEvent` on the changed path (**and**, for a sidecar
path, on the file it belongs to)→`useFileSourceEvents(['update'])` consumer reload, through the
2 s data cache — plus, for a consumer with a cache of its own, that cache's own invalidation
(XW-08). Adding or removing a file takes the OTHER half of `handleFileEvent`, the readdir diff
→ `dirSource.fireRefreshEvent()` (XW-10).

> **A disk write is the cheapest XW driver, and the only one that needs no OS focus.**
> Rewriting the file with `node -e` (or writing a `<file>.histories/<n>-head`, which is exactly
> what an editor window does — KB §12.2b) exercises watch→alert→cache→render end to end. Every
> XW row below can be driven that way against a **scratch** file; the editor window is needed
> only when the row is about the editor's own UI.

A run that checks only the body ABOVE the stages (XW-06) passes while both are broken. Verified live 2026-08-11: both write shapes, both panes, <1 s. ⚠️ Two later changes, **not re-verified live**: the refresh now runs from `LyricManager.refreshOpenLyricContent()` in the previewer's own `update` handler — **content first, `clearCache()` second**, because a pane re-deriving between the two re-fills the cache from the pre-edit text — and watch events are debounced 500 ms, so allow ~1 s rather than expecting it instantly                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| XW-09 | **The watch is data-dir-wide, lazy, and sidecar-aware** (src: src/helper/dirWatchingHelpers.ts `watchDataDir` / `alertFileChanging` · src/helper/FileSource.ts `registerEventListener*`)                                                     | with a file's consumer open while its **list is not mounted** (hide the Documents list widget, keep the document previewed), change that file on disk; then write into a sidecar dir — `<file>.histories/<n>-head`, and a `<name>.pptx-htmls` / `-images` entry if one exists — and watch the ORIGINAL file's consumers                        | ONE recursive `fs.watch` covers the whole **data parent dir**, so propagation no longer depends on which list is mounted (it used to need that dir's own `DirSource` alive via `useDirSourceWatching`), and it is started lazily on the first `FileSource` listener — nothing watches before a window subscribes. A write inside a sidecar fires `update` for BOTH the sidecar path and the file it belongs to (`fileExtraSuffixes` = `.histories` · `-htmls` · `-images`), the original only if it still exists. The suffix test must come FIRST: an ordinary file change may not spend an extra `fsCheckFileExist` on a non-existent "original"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| XW-10 | **File added / removed on disk → the list refreshes** (the readdir half of `handleFileEvent`) (src: src/helper/dirWatchingHelpers.ts `handleFileEvent`)                                                                                      | with the Documents list open, copy a scratch `.owl` into the documents dir and wait ~5 s; then delete it and wait ~5 s; repeat in a second list (Videos/Images) if time allows                                                                                                                                                                 | the new row appears and the deleted row disappears **without** a manual Reload: `handleFileEvent` diffs the directory listing against `dirSource.filePathsMap` and calls `fireRefreshEvent()` — the only thing that clears that map (the list menu's **Reload** fires `reload`, which does not, so a stale entry survives Reload too). ⚠️ **Measured live 2026-08-11 (refactor28): FAILED**, for TWO reasons, both since fixed in code and **re-verified live PASSING on 2026-08-13** (run `20260813-2138`: a scratch `.owl` copied into the documents dir appeared as a row within 1.5 s, and deleting it plus its `.histories` dir removed the row within 3 s — no manual Reload either way). (1) The watch root is the data PARENT dir, so `handleFileEvent` receives `dirPath` = the parent and `name` = `documents\<file>.owl`; `alertFileChanging` still resolved the right path (which is why XW-08 passed), but the diff called `DirSource.getInstance(dirPath)` — whose argument is a **setting name**, not a path — so it built and cached a junk `DirSource` with `dirPath: ''` and fired `refresh` at nobody. Now resolved through `DirSource.getInstanceByDirPath(pathDirname(filePath))`, i.e. the CHANGED FILE's own directory, skipped when no list is mounted on it. (2) The DELETE half could not have worked either: a path that is neither a file nor a directory returned early, before the reconcile. The existence check is gone from that path — a vanished entry now still reconciles its directory. Note the events are debounced 500 ms, so allow ~1 s before reading the list |

## SP — Screen controlling (mini-screen previewer) — **MANDATORY core: SP-01..02**

Every screen gets its own previewer card (`ScreenPreviewerItemComp`): header =
`ShowHideScreen` + `MiniScreenClearControlComp` + screen-id badge + color note + lock;
body = live preview (drop target, right-click menu); footer = `DisplayControl` +
transition effects + background-audio switch + stage number. Sources in
[components-path.md](./components-path.md) §Presenter-right.

## SC — `screen.html` (presentation output window) — **MANDATORY core: SC-01..02**

> **CDP facts (verified 2026-07-08):** while a screen is SHOWING it **is** a normal CDP
> target — `https://localhost:3000/screen.html?screenId=N` in `list_pages`, fully
> drivable (snapshot / click / screenshot). The target vanishes when the screen hides;
> a hidden screen's console forwards to the **electron main stdout** (the `npm run dev`
> terminal) via `all:app:log`. Never `navigate_page` the main window to `screen.html` —
> reach it only through SP-01 + `list_pages`. Screen-only bugs (e.g. full-width PDF) do
> NOT reproduce in the presenter's mini preview — that is why driving the real target is
> mandatory.

| ID    | Target                                                                                       | Interactions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Pass condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SC-01 | Screen target attach                                                                         | present content → SP-01 show → `list_pages` → `select_page` → readiness → screenshot                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | the `screen.html?screenId=N` target MUST appear and be drivable; screenshot captured from the screen target itself (not just the mini preview)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| SC-02 | Layer rendering on the real output                                                           | while bg + slide + bible + foreground are live                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | all live layers composite correctly **on the screen target's own screenshot**, and the mini-screen mirrors it; compare the two for screen-only rendering bugs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| SC-03 | ⌨️ `Ctrl/Alt+ArrowLeft/Right` on the screen target                                           | with a bible verse live, `press_key` on the selected screen page                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | bible verse steps prev/next on the output (mirror on mini-screen)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| SC-04 | `ScreenCloseButtonComp` (❌ `#close`)                                                        | 🖱️ on the screen target                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | screen hides; its CDP target disappears; the presenter's `ShowHideScreen` reflects hidden                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| SC-05 | Hidden-screen log forwarding                                                                 | after hiding, trigger screen activity; read the `npm run dev` terminal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | screen console lines arrive via `all:app:log` on electron-main stdout (use this channel when hunting screen-only bugs while hidden)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| SC-06 | Output window invalid/missing `screenId` error state (`ScreenAppComp` null-manager branch)   | observe `screen.html` loaded with no / NaN `screenId`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `useScreenManager` returns null → a red "Screen ID is not provided in the URL…" panel on black renders and the `#close` button is force-shown (`opacity:1`), whose click calls `globalThis.close()` (no manager to hide); likely BLOCKED at runtime since it is reachable only via a stray target — never `navigate_page` the main window to `screen.html` (src: src/_screen/ScreenAppComp.tsx:16-32,64-95; src/_screen/ScreenCloseButtonComp.tsx:15-29)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| SC-07 | Output window auto-reload on resize (`screen.tsx` window `resize` listener)                  | resize the showing `screen.html` window (`resize_page`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | The `window` `resize` event calls `appProvider.reload()`, so the screen target reloads (assets refetch, target briefly re-inits then reattaches in `list_pages`); drive only on a non-live display, else EX-02 (src: src/screen.tsx:40-42)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| SC-08 | **Lyric previewer↔screen render parity** (run on a COLD start, before any reload/re-present) | change **Extra Font Size** in the stage's ⚙ panel (PM-117) FIRST, then present a lyric slide, show the screen, and measure the same slide on both sides: `getComputedStyle` of `.ol-preview-line, .ol-preview-lyric-segment__text` inside `#slide` on the `screen.html` target vs. inside each presenter `ShadowingFillParentWidthComp` shadow root | `fontSize` and `color` MUST match. A screen showing open-lyric's raw `16px` default while the previewer shows the configured size (`DEFAULT_OPEN_LYRIC_FONT_SIZE + extraSlideFontSize`, e.g. 61px) is a **High** finding — lyric slide HTML is generated by the `open-lyric` dep and its options come from state that only the presenter's `LyricSlidesPreviewerComp` populates, so init-order bugs surface on the first present after launch and "heal" after a re-present. Since 2026-08-07g the size also comes from `lyric-stage-style-<stage>.extraFontSize`, which is deliberately UNPREFIXED — a screen that renders the default 61px while the previewer shows the configured size means the two sides resolved different setting keys. The mini preview does NOT reliably expose it (KB §13; src: src/lyric-list/LyricAppDocumentStageAbstract.ts, src/lyric-list/LyricSlidesPreviewerComp.tsx:32) |

## CM — Context-menu items (right-click actions)

Each distinct right-click menu ITEM as its own unit (triggers are in PL/PM/SP/GL rows). Destructive items = confirm→Cancel (EX-05) or act on a scratch item.

- Emoji: 🖱️ click · 🖱️🖱️ dblclick · 🖱️R right-click · ⇕ drag · ⌨️ key ·
  🎚️ slider · ⌨️✎ input · 🖐️ hover.
- **(family)** = one row consolidating the same item across sibling hosts.
- **[D]** = destructive item; pass = confirm dialog appears → **Cancel (EX-05)**,
  or act on a scratch item created for the purpose.
- Assert the open item set with
  `[...document.querySelectorAll('#app-context-menu-container .app-context-menu-item')].map(e=>e.textContent)`.

## LT — Locale & theme passes — **MANDATORY core: LT-01..02**

> **Why LT-02 is mandatory, not a spot-check.** `tran()`
> (src: src/lang/langHelpers.ts:601-625) short-circuits when the locale is `en-US`
> (`DEFAULT_LOCALE`) and returns the input string — **no dictionary lookup happens**. In
> `km-KH` the same call **throws** `Translation for text "…" not found in locale km-KH`
> when the key is absent, and there is no error boundary, so the component's whole
> subtree renders **blank**. An English-only run therefore cannot detect a missing
> translation _at all_, and `npm run lint` (tests + typecheck + build) stays green while
> a screen is broken in Khmer. Observed 2026-07-26: `PositionSizeFieldComp` called
> `tran(name)` with `name="X:"` and blanked the entire slide-editor tools panel.
>
> Since 2026-09-18 (`EN-20`) `src/lang/tranKeyCoverage.test.ts`, inside `npm run lint`,
> fails on any STATIC key the Khmer dictionary lacks — a literal, a concatenation
> (`tran('a ' + 'b')` is ONE key at runtime, and the test reads it as one) or a string
> constant. What only a live locale switch can still find is the **dynamic** `tran(prop)`
> fed by a JSX literal at the call site, a key built at runtime, and a `tran()` that runs
> before the window's language data has loaded.

| ID    | Target                                          | Interactions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Pass condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| LT-01 | Primary pass                                    | full matrix in the CURRENT locale/theme; record which locale that was (read it from Settings → Language's active button, NOT `localStorage`)                                                                                                    | (this is the main run); the starting locale is captured so LT-02 can restore it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| LT-02 | **Secondary locale pass (MANDATORY)**           | switch via ST-04 → `Apply Settings` (reloads every window: re-`list_pages`/`select_page`, all `uid`s die); re-walk every screen the run touched + the presenter baseline; screenshot + `list_console_messages` each; then switch back and Apply | **no `Translation for text "…" not found in locale km-KH` in any console** (each occurrence = Critical finding: name the key AND the component from the React warning that follows); no blank/empty panel that rendered in the other locale; labels actually translate (KB §1 map), no raw i18n keys, no clipped/overflowing Khmer text; starting locale **restored** |
| LT-03 | Dark theme spot-check                           | via ST-05; screenshot presenter + settings                                                                                                                                                                                                      | readable contrast; no invisible text; **restore**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| LT-04 | Light theme spot-check                          | via ST-05                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | same; **restore**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| LT-05 | `SettingGeneralThemeComp` "System" theme option | ⌨️✎ theme `<select>` → "System"; emulate OS `prefers-color-scheme`; **restore**                                                                                                                                                                 | app follows the OS scheme — `data-bs-theme`/documentElement resolves to OS light/dark and flips when the emulated OS scheme flips (distinct from LT-03 dark / LT-04 light); restore original theme (src: src/setting/SettingGeneralThemeComp.tsx:31-34)                                                                                                               |

## MD — Media download from URL (mandatory core, needs network)

The only rows that exercise the external binaries. `downloadVideoOrAudio`
(`src/server/appHelpers.ts`) spawns `extra-bin/<platform>/yt/yt-dlp`, pointing it at
`extra-bin/<platform>/ffmpeg/bin` (`--ffmpeg-location`) and `extra-bin/<platform>/qjs/qjs`
(`--no-js-runtimes --js-runtimes quickjs:<path>`).

**Those three are NOT in the app package.** They live in
`<data parent dir>/extra-bin/` (dev: `Desktop\open-worship-data-dev\extra-bin`) and
are installed on demand from **Settings → Others → Extra Binaries** — so `MD-05`
runs FIRST on any machine where the pack is absent, and `MD-06` is the guard that
makes the absence visible instead of a cryptic spawn failure. In dev the install
copies `extra-work/experiment-building/release/bin-<ver>.tar.gz`, which `npm i`
builds (the `install` lifecycle → `extra-work/build.sh`); nothing is downloaded.

Use the canonical link from the mandatory-core section above.

| ID    | Target                                                                     | Interactions                                                                                         | Pass condition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| MD-01 | Video download from URL (`BackgroundVideosComp`)                           | 🖱️R Videos tab empty area → `Download From URL` → ⌨️✎ link → `Ok`                                    | progress bar runs; the finished file appears in the videos dir AND as a new thumbnail in the tab (dir listing refreshes itself). yt-dlp merges video+audio via ffmpeg, so a merged container proves the shipped ffmpeg works (src: src/background/BackgroundVideosComp.tsx:160-201 · src/server/appHelpers.ts:219-323). **On FAILURE the toast now names the cause** — `Error occurred during downloading video: <reason>`, the reason being the LAST `ERROR:` line of the yt-dlp transcript with its `[extractor] <id>:` scope and the `Download failed:` wrapper stripped, capped at 200 chars (`toDownloadFailureReason`, src/background/downloadHelper.tsx). A bare sentence with no reason after it means the rejection carried nothing parseable, not that the reason was dropped. Untranslated on purpose: it is upstream tool output |
| MD-02 | Audio download from URL (`BackgroundAudiosComp`)                           | 🖱️R ♫Audios♫ split empty area → `Download From URL` → ⌨️✎ same link → `Ok`                           | popup label reads **Audio URL:** (not Video URL); result is an **`.mp3`** in the audios dir — the app passes `-x --audio-format mp3 --audio-quality 0`, so this is the only row proving the shipped ffmpeg has an mp3 encoder (`libmp3lame`) (src: src/background/BackgroundAudiosComp.tsx:32-76)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| MD-03 | Invalid-URL guard (`askForURL`)                                            | ⌨️✎ a non-`http` string → `Ok`                                                                       | no download starts; toast "Invalid URL". Empty input marks the box `is-invalid` (src: src/background/downloadHelper.tsx:54-78)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| MD-04 | **Teardown — remove what MD-01/MD-02 wrote** [D]                           | 🖱️R the new video row → `Move to Trash` → `Yes`; same for the new `.mp3` row                         | each row leaves its tab immediately (no manual reload) and the file is gone from the videos/audios dir — it goes to the OS Recycle Bin via `shell.trashItem`, so it is recoverable, not shredded. End state: **no copy of the canonical title and no `temp-*.part` in either dir**. Doubles as CM-06 coverage on a background media row, against the one file the trash rule allows deleting — the scratch file this run created (src: src/others/FileItemHandlerComp.tsx:77 · src/background/BackgroundMediaItemComp.tsx:89)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| MD-05 | **Extra Binaries panel** (`SettingOthersExtraBinComp`) — runs BEFORE MD-01 | ST tab `Others` → read the card; if `Not installed`, 🖱️ `Download and Install`; then 🖱️ `Re-extract` | the card names the `extra-bin` folder, an installed version and the latest available one (`Could not check for updates` is acceptable offline, and must NOT blank the installed half). After installing, `<data parent>\extra-bin` holds `yt/`, `ffmpeg/bin/`, `qjs/`, `info.json` **and the `bin-*.tar.gz` — the archive is kept on purpose**, so `Re-extract` succeeds with no network. When the published pack is newer the primary button reads `Update to <ver>` and, after it runs, the superseded `bin-*.tar.gz` is gone (src: src/setting/SettingOthersExtraBinComp.tsx · src/helper/extra-bin/extraBinInstallHelpers.ts)                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| MD-06 | **Missing-pack guard** (`requireExtraBinPaths`)                            | rename/remove `<data parent>\extra-bin\<platform>\yt`, then run MD-01's `Download From URL`          | a confirm dialog **Media Tools Required** naming the missing binaries; `No` cancels with **no second "download failed" toast**; `Yes` opens Settings on the `Others` tab. **No yt-dlp process is spawned either way.** Restore the folder (or re-run MD-05) afterwards (src: src/helper/extra-bin/extraBinHelpers.ts · src/background/BackgroundVideosComp.tsx)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

**MD-04 in detail — the block owns its own garbage.** Each canonical download is ~100 MB
of video plus ~5 MB of mp3, and the app de-duplicates by suffixing rather than
overwriting, so an uncleaned block is not idempotent: it adds a fresh copy every run. On
2026-08-07 the dev data dir held **17 stale copies — ≈635 MB** — left
by earlier runs, and they had to be swept by hand; that is what this row exists to stop.

1. **Sweep first, download second.** Before MD-01, list the two dirs and delete any
   leftovers from earlier runs — they all carry the **canonical video's page title**
   (`[MV] គ្រប់ទាំងផ្កា Flowers by … - Official Music Video - YouTube`, with a ` (N)`
   suffix from the second copy on). Match that title, not `YouTube` (step 3). Report the
   count in the run's note — leftovers mean a previous run skipped MD-04.
2. **Prefer the app's own delete** (the row above): it proves CM-06, refreshes the list
   through the real `delete` event, and also trashes the material files
   (`trashAllMaterialFiles`). The **Move to Trash** entry is **hidden while the item is on
   a screen** (`isInScreen`, PM-35) — clear/hide the screen first or the menu looks broken.
3. **On-disk fallback** (item never appeared in the list, download failed halfway, or the
   app is already closed). Two traps: the names start with `[MV]`, and `[` is a
   character-class metacharacter for PowerShell's `-Path` (filter objects and pipe them,
   never glob); and **`*YouTube*` is far too broad a match** — the user's own library
   holds legitimately-downloaded files whose names end in `- YouTube` too (verified
   2026-08-07: `ស្រែកថ្វាយព្រះអង្គ Shout to the Lord - YouTube.MKV`, `4K Christian Church
Worship … - YouTube.mp4`). Match the **canonical video's title**:

   ```powershell
   $dirs = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\open-worship-data-dev\videos",
           "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\open-worship-data-dev\audios"
   $dirs | ForEach-Object {
       Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_ |
           Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*Flowers by*Official Music Video - YouTube*' -or
                          $_.Name -like 'temp-*' } |
           Remove-Item   # binds PSPath → -LiteralPath, so the brackets are safe
   }
   ```

   List the matches before deleting anything, and prefer the Recycle Bin over
   `Remove-Item` when sweeping someone's data dir:
   `[Microsoft.VisualBasic.FileIO.FileSystem]::DeleteFile($p,'OnlyErrorDialogs','SendToRecycleBin')`
   (after `Add-Type -AssemblyName Microsoft.VisualBasic`).

   (Dev data lives in `…\Desktop\open-worship-data-dev`, NOT the non-`-dev` dir; if the
   folder settings were changed, read the actual path off the Background panel's
   folder-path bar.) A file deleted behind the app's back leaves a **stale thumbnail**
   until the tab is reloaded — expected, not a finding.

4. Deleting is **not** optional on failure: a run that reports MD-01/MD-02 BLOCKED still
   sweeps, because a partial download leaves the biggest debris.
5. The sweep covers the **downloaded media only**. `<data parent>\extra-bin` (~27 MB
   archive + ~36 MB extracted) is the installed tool pack, not this run's garbage — leave
   it. Deleting it just makes the next run re-install it, and MD-06 already proves the
   absent case by moving one folder aside temporarily.

**Reading a failure — do not report it as a code bug without this triage:**

0. **Is the pack installed at all?** Check `<data parent>\extra-bin` for
   `yt/yt-dlp.exe`, `ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe` and `qjs/qjs.exe`. Missing means MD-05 was
   skipped — the app should have shown the **Media Tools Required** dialog, and if it ran
   yt-dlp anyway that IS a bug (MD-06).
1. `ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden` (often mid-transfer,
   after tens of MB) is **YouTube-side throttling**, not the app. It is likeliest when the
   same video was pulled minutes earlier. Retry once before filing anything.
2. Confirm which layer broke by running the binary directly — a 10 KB probe that does not
   touch the app:
   `extra-bin\<platform>\yt\yt-dlp.exe --no-js-runtimes --js-runtimes quickjs:<qjs> --no-playlist --test -o <tmp>\p.%(ext)s <link>`
   (`--test` truncates to 10 KB; the trailing `Postprocessing: Conversion failed!` is
   expected from truncated input and is NOT a failure).
3. `WARNING: No supported JavaScript runtime could be found` = the qjs copy is missing or
   the flags regressed → real Critical finding. Verify with `-v`: the debug header must
   read `JS runtimes: quickjs-<version>` and the extractor line `[jsc:quickjs] Solving JS
challenges using quickjs`.
4. **Known app bug (pre-existing, do not re-file as new):** a failed download leaves its
   `temp-<ts>.f<fmt>.*.part` behind in the data dir — the error path only checks for the
   final file. MD-04 removes it; note that it had to.
5. A download that succeeds when the destination name already exists lands as
   `<name> (1).<ext>` — expected de-duplication, not a bug. But seeing `(1)` at all on the
   **first** download of a run means MD-04 was skipped last time (step 1 above).

BLOCKED is acceptable **only** with no network; say so in `note`. Never mark MD PASS from
a toast alone — check the file on disk (or the refreshed thumbnail), per the evidence
rule. MD-04 is never BLOCKED by "no network": with nothing downloaded it is the sweep
alone, and it still runs.

Two independent causes, both fixed 2026-09-01. (1) `owa_help_search {query: "show screen", focus: "presenter"}` used to answer `W-20` at score 84 above `W-10` at 59, because a term of four letters or more matched the START of any longer word with no bound on the rest — so **"screen" matched "Screencast"** in a page TITLE, worth 14. 45 such pairs were live in the corpus (`copy`→`copyright`, `song`→`SongSelect`, `back`→`background`, `down`→`download`, `stop`→`stopwatch`), 229 occurrences, 10 in a title; the tail is now capped at three characters, which keeps every inflection this corpus needs (`verses` +1, `lookup` +2, `presenting` +3) and cuts all 45, the shortest of which adds four. Coverage is also weighted by inverse frequency instead of counting words, and no longer squared: "How do I move to the next slide?" scored its own answer (W-03, _"step through slides … Arrow keys"_) 7 against 27 for a page merely saying "move", "next" and "slide". Graded on the 236-question corpus as a labelled set: top-1 136 → **140**, top-3 179 → **186**; 45 held-out paraphrases 21 → **23**; per query 9 fixed / 3 broken (src: tools/owa-devtools-mcp/help.mjs `countTerm`, `scoreCounts`). (2) The two buttons under a model-written answer took the top manual hit of the model's FIRST search and could never revise it — not when it refined the query, not when it opened a different page with `owa_help_page`, not when it answered from `owa_list_screens`. A page the model OPENED now wins (last one wins), a later search overwrites an earlier one, and a model that started its own card with `owa_guide_start` is offered no button at all (src: src/chatbot/llmBotHelpers.ts `applyToolWatch`, `toWatchedManualId`). Finished steps stay above the running one and go dim; **exactly one dot is ever breathing**, which is what makes it readable at a glance. Every phrase is written for a volunteer and names what it is working ON — `Searching the guide for "background"`, `Reading example.com` (the site, not the whole address), `Pressing "Clear Bible"`, `Creating a new song: "Amazing Grace"`, `Writing the song out` — and **no tool name, path or id may ever appear**, including for a tool added to the server later, which falls back to `Looking something up`. A step is opened by the code about to do the thing and closed by the code that finished it, so nothing is left spinning under a finished answer and a step whose round THREW is still closed. The list keeps the last 5 and counts the rest (`3 earlier steps`) rather than dropping them in silence. It clears when a question starts, when one ends, and at the press of **Stop** (CB-23). The steps ride their own store, not the window's state, so a twenty-step question does not re-render the conversation twenty times. ## Row counts (for the coverage denominator)

GL 25 · NAV 23 · PL 105 · PM 127 · PR 31 · RD 121 · ED 46 · ST 56 · PU 20 · SP 22 · SC 8 · XW 10 · EX 7 · CM 99 · KB 60 · LT 5 · MD 6 · AP 8 · CB 78 · PC 1 = **858 rows total**. Compute the
denominator per run as `858 − EXCLUDED` (hardware and policy exclusions vary by machine).

> These counts are re-derived from the table itself
> (`grep -oE "^\| ([A-Z]{2,3})-[0-9]+ "` → sort → uniq -c), not maintained by hand — they
> had drifted 35 rows behind it before 2026-08-04h, 9 again before 2026-08-05j, and the
> whole **AP** block (8 rows) was missing from the sum until 2026-08-07f, and it was
> 15 rows behind again (651 vs 666) until 2026-08-08i — and 7 behind (678 vs 685, the
> whole RD-65..RD-71 tail) until 2026-08-09 — and duplicated IDs (CM-36..39, SP-18 each
> assigned twice) hid 5 rows until 2026-08-30.
> Re-run that count whenever you add
> rows. **PL is no longer dev-gated**: none of PL-10 / PL-29 / PL-32..PL-99 may be
> excluded as "dev-only" (PL-49).

> Reminder: whatever the focus area, the **mandatory core** — screen (SP-01, SP-02,
> SC-01, SC-02, PR-04, one clear key), **locale (LT-01, LT-02)** and **media download
> (MD-01, MD-02) plus its teardown (MD-04)** — must appear in every run's state file.
